3yhealth-3y-health:ashbyhq:b47d0dc8-b5d4.title: Operations Associate
3yhealth-3y-health:ashbyhq:b47d0dc8-b5d4.description: About Us At 3Y Health, we are building AI-driven software to empower healthcare providers and solve the overwhelming administrative complexity that consumes 40% of the industry’s revenue. Our end-to-end platform unlocks opportunities for clinician entrepreneurs, enabling medical professionals to launch, run, and grow private practices. By supporting these independent practices with the latest AI and automation, we’re helping providers reclaim their time, build thriving businesses, and deliver better outcomes for their communities. 3Y Health is backed by over $200M from top-tier investors including Founders Fund, General Catalyst, Softbank, and 8VC. About the Role We’re hiring an Operations Associate to keep our internal systems and client workflows running smoothly. This is a cross-functional role perfect for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, loves solving logistical puzzles, and is excited to support a mission-driven team. You’ll work closely with our clinical, client success, and leadership teams to ensure day-to-day operations are efficient, reliable, and scalable. RESPONSIBILITIES - Own day-to-day operational logistics across client and clinician workflows - Set up and monitor key internal systems (scheduling, intake tracking, reporting dashboards) - Coordinate referrals, onboarding steps, and scheduling between multiple stakeholders - Respond to clinician and client support needs with a “find the fix” mindset - Document repeatable processes and propose improvements as we grow - Help build internal dashboards and trackers to monitor service delivery and team capacity - Support special projects (e.g. launching new employer clients, onboarding new providers) - Pitch in wherever needed—this is a startup and we all roll up our sleeves Qualifications - 1–3 years experience in operations, admin, project coordination, or client support—ideally in a startup, healthcare, or tech-enabled services environment - Super organized and proactive—you anticipate needs before they arise - Comfortable working in spreadsheets, tools like Airtable or Notion, and willing to learn new tech quickly - A clear and professional communicator (email, Zoom, Slack) - Calm under pressure, with a problem-solving mindset - Excited to work on a small team where your input matters and your role will evolve Compensation The estimated salary range for this role is $100,000-120,000. Total compensation for this position may also include stock options. Note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors.

blackwhitezebra-black-white-zebra:lever:.title: Off-Page SEO Manager
blackwhitezebra-black-white-zebra:lever:.description: About the Role: BWZ is looking for an Off-Page SEO Manager to build our link-acquisition engine from the ground up. We're investing in a more diversified, sustainable authority acquisition strategy. You'll manage existing vendor relationships while building and scaling off-page link acquisition initiatives. Reporting to our Senior SEO Manager, you'll partner closely with our Content team to turn our tools and resources into genuine linkable assets. Who you are: You're a self-starter who's comfortable operating with more ambiguity than structure — you'll need to generate ideas, test them, and figure out what works with limited playbook to lean on. You understand what separates a good link from a bad one, and you're not precious about starting with unglamorous, manual work (vendor management, reclamation, cold outreach) while building toward something more systematic. You think in terms of repeatable processes, not one-off wins — you're the kind of person who turns "we got a link" into "here's how we get links like this every month." What you'll be doing (responsibilities): Own the end-to-end vendor relationship lifecycle, including sourcing, negotiation, quality review, performance tracking, and ongoing optimization Build and scale BWZ's earned and owned link acquisition capabilities — including reclamation, partner and reciprocal link-swap relationships, and outreach tied to linkable assets Partner with our Content team to turn calculators, templates, and resource pages into outreach-ready linkable assets — owning the recipient lists, outreach, embed tracking, and reporting for each campaign Evaluate external link partnership platforms and provide recommendations on long-term partnership strategy Track and report clear numbers monthly: total links acquired, cost per link, and the shifting split between sources Grow the contribution of earned and owned acquisition channels over time How your success will be measured: New Quality Links Acquired: Total new links per month meeting our quality bar across all channels — reclamation, partner swaps, data outreach, and linkable-asset/badge campaigns Channel scale & diversity — Growth in the number of durable, repeatable acquisition channels producing quality links, so authority comes from a resilient mix of sources rather than any single dependency Acquisition efficiency — Blended cost and effort per quality link trending down over time as owned and earned channels scale and mature. Your skillset includes: 3+ years of hands-on experience in link building, link acquisition, or a closely related SEO discipline Strong relationship-building instincts — comfortable initiating and nurturing recurring partnerships with external stakeholders (editors, SEO managers, site owners, agencies) over time, not just one-off transactional outreach Working understanding of what makes a link valuable (relevance, authority, placement) versus low-quality or risky Comfort with outreach and SEO research tooling (e.g., Pitchbox, Ahrefs/SEMrush, email outreach platforms) A self-directed, experimental approach — able to propose an idea, test it, and iterate without heavy oversight Strong organization and reporting instincts — you naturally track what's working, what isn't, and why Nice to haves: Experience specifically with vendor/paid-link program management Familiarity with link-swap or marketplace platforms Experience building or promoting "linkable assets" (calculators, tools, badge/award campaigns) as a growth channel Background in B2B media, SaaS, or content-driven organizations

crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:2f.title: Field Accountant
crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:2f.description: Come join our team at Optimal! We know a few things about competing with giants and exceeding expectations. After years of working in the field, our founders decided to break from tradition and build the company they wanted to work for. They believed in starting a company rooted in trust, its team, and the idea that everyone matters and has a part in getting the job done right. Quickly building a reputation from the ground up and growing the company along with our list of clients, Optimal is now influencing the industry and the people we serve. We live by the values that make us who we are. And that is how we deliver the impossible for our clients and team members every day. Optimal Field Services, is looking to add an experienced Field Accountant to our team. The Field Accountant for Optimal Field Services will be responsible for coordination, tracking and documentation of all aspects of timekeeping and client billing. This position will work collaboratively with the job site and home office staff. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Complies employee time and production records. Reviews timesheets, work charts, and timecards for completeness. Receive, verify, and file all time exception forms. Reconcile all timecard exceptions. Run all necessary reports and payroll processing. Produce reports, letters, and other correspondence as needed. Administrative support to Project Management, Superintendent, and General Foreman. Prioritize work to meet goals and objectives within acceptable time frames. Carry out assigned projects to their completion. Prepare and complete Cost Reports for both inhouse and client requirements. Prepare and submit inhouse and client billing. Perform other duties as assigned. REQUIREMENTS FOR Field Accountant: High School Diploma or equivalent preferred. TWIC and OSHA. Experience using Microsoft Word, Excel, Access, and Outlook is preferred. Have a minimum of one-year experience using track software. 3+ years of timekeeping experience in construction/turnaround environments. Must be able to document and interpret time. Must be able to track multiple jobs simultaneously. Strong attention detail and analytical abilities. Must be available to travel.

emergence-emergence:ashbyhq:d91a1451-a6a.title: Senior AI Engineer
emergence-emergence:ashbyhq:d91a1451-a6a.description: Senior AI Engineer - Systems & Integration, Emergence | India - Remote | Full-Time Who We Are Emergence is a thematic holding company backed by the Pritzker Organization focused exclusively on acquiring and scaling category-defining software businesses. We invest in focused portfolios, specialized operating groups with deep domain expertise and proven playbooks. Emergence combines operational rigor with a growth equity mindset, driving sustainable ARR growth, profitability improvements, and industry-leading customer outcomes. The Mission Design and deploy production AI systems that integrate cleanly across multiple backend services, enabling portfolio companies to embed AI at scale. What You'll Do - Design end-to-end AI integration architectures connecting LLM APIs, vector databases, and inference systems to existing backend infrastructure. - Build reusable ML infrastructure components like feature pipelines, model serving layers, and evaluation frameworks that multiple portfolio companies standardize on. - Establish AI system integration best practices and governance patterns that become repeatable playbooks across the holding company. - Own system design reviews for AI initiatives across portfolio companies, identifying bottlenecks and recommending architectural improvements. - Optimize production AI systems for cost and latency by profiling pipelines, implementing compression, and right-sizing compute infrastructure. - Mentor engineers at portfolio companies on production AI best practices, reproducibility, monitoring, and safe deployment patterns. What We're Looking For Must-haves - 5+ years building backend systems or integrations with hands-on experience connecting multiple third-party tools and APIs in production. - Proven track record architecting system integrations at scale that reduced integration time or standardized tooling across teams. - Strong Python and SQL skills for building data pipelines and backend services that feed AI systems. - Hands-on production experience deploying LLM applications, vector search systems, ML inference pipelines, or automated workflows. - Deep understanding of integrating external AI tools into existing backend architectures without requiring core system rearchitecture. - Built systems that are monitored, versioned, and reproducible, not one-off prototypes or experiments. Nice-to-haves - Experience with MLOps platforms like MLflow, Weights & Biases, or SageMaker, or ML infrastructure tooling. - Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, or cloud deployment on AWS, GCP, or Azure for containerizing AI services. - Experience building retrieval-augmented generation systems or scaling prompt engineering across teams. Who you are You've spent your career solving integration problems across backend systems. You identify inefficient patterns and design reusable abstractions that eliminate duplicate work. You expand your scope by owning problems that multiple teams depend on. You mentor others on production best practices without being asked. You set up monitoring and validation before shipping, and you refuse to compromise on quality even under deadline pressure. You solicit feedback from dependent teams before finalizing designs. You refactor inherited systems to reduce technical debt and improve reproducibility, leaving measurable quality improvements behind. What We Offer - Remote work from India with flexibility on location. - Professional development budget and conference attendance. - Work directly with multiple portfolio companies to shape how AI scales across a holding company.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:68bf801c-6a73-.title: Senior HR Business Partner
jobgether-jobgether:lever:68bf801c-6a73-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior HR Business Partner based in United States. This is a hands-on HR leadership role responsible for building and operating the people processes that support a rapidly scaling organization. You will own critical employee lifecycle programs, from onboarding and offboarding to performance management and career development. The role also includes implementing and optimizing an HRIS to create scalable, efficient workflows as the organization grows. You’ll partner closely with managers and employees, balancing strategic HR judgment with day-to-day execution. A strong focus on AI-enabled process improvement will help modernize HR operations while maintaining appropriate compliance and documentation. You’ll work in a fast-paced, growth-stage environment where you can build foundational programs and have a meaningful impact on company culture and employee experience. Own the implementation and ongoing configuration of the HRIS, including job architecture, workflows, employee lifecycle processes, and system setup needed to support organizational growth. Lead performance review, merit, promotion, and calibration cycles, ensuring processes are effective, consistent, and well communicated. Develop and evolve career pathing frameworks that provide employees with clear expectations and opportunities for professional growth. Build and operate effective onboarding and offboarding programs that create a strong employee experience while maintaining consistent and compliant processes. Manage employee recognition programs and contribute to learning and development initiatives that strengthen manager and employee capabilities. Support benefits administration and annual broker renewal activities, helping ensure rewards and benefits remain competitive, efficient, and clearly understood. Support employer-sponsored immigration and mobility needs, including H-1B-related processes, in collaboration with external counsel. Partner directly with managers on performance, employee development, and people-related decisions, providing practical and trusted HR guidance. Use AI-powered tools and modern HR technology to streamline workflows, improve efficiency, track outcomes, and scale people operations responsibly. Maintain accurate documentation and compliant tracking across HR processes, with appropriate attention to data handling, consistency, and bias mitigation. Continuously identify opportunities to improve people programs and operational processes as the organization grows. Requirements: 8+ years of experience in HR, HR Business Partner, or comparable people-focused roles. Demonstrated experience building and operating HR processes within a growth-stage organization. Hands-on experience implementing and configuring an HRIS such as Rippling or a comparable platform, including job architecture, workflows, and onboarding/offboarding processes. Direct experience running performance reviews, merit cycles, promotion processes, and/or calibration programs. Experience developing or supporting career pathing frameworks. Experience building or managing employee recognition and/or learning and development programs. Experience using AI-powered tools to make HR processes more efficient and scalable, with a strong understanding of compliant use, data handling, documentation, and avoiding bias in AI-assisted decisions. Strong ability to combine strategic HR thinking with hands-on operational execution. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the credibility to advise managers while maintaining the trust of employees. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, particularly when managing recurring HR processes and sensitive employee information. Experience operating in an enterprise SaaS environment is preferred. Multi-entity or international HR experience is a plus. Familiarity with Pave, Carta, or comparable com

jobgether-jobgether:lever:be58fd5a-2e8e-.title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Python Especialista I (Plataforma e Serviços)
jobgether-jobgether:lever:be58fd5a-2e8e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Python Especialista I (Plataforma e Serviços) based in Brazil. This is a senior backend engineering opportunity focused on modernizing critical platforms and building scalable, resilient services. You will help transform a legacy monolithic architecture into a modern ecosystem of Python-based microservices. The role sits at the intersection of backend engineering, cloud architecture, event-driven systems, and technical governance. You will work on high-impact initiatives involving AWS, Kafka, RabbitMQ, REST APIs, observability, and asynchronous integrations. AI-powered development tools are an integral part of the engineering workflow, enabling faster delivery and continuous improvement. You will also act as a technical reference, influencing architectural decisions and collaborating independently across teams and squads. The environment values engineering excellence, autonomy, strong documentation, and practical solutions designed for scale and long-term sustainability. Design, develop, and evolve resilient, high-performance microservices using Python , following scalable and maintainable engineering practices. Lead and execute the migration and decoupling of critical business domains from a legacy .NET monolith into a modern Python-based platform. Design and maintain asynchronous integrations using Kafka and/or RabbitMQ , as well as robust RESTful APIs. Promote high standards of software quality through unit, integration, and end-to-end testing, as well as thorough code reviews. Architect and maintain cloud solutions in AWS , prioritizing resilience, high availability, scalability, and efficient infrastructure costs. Implement and evolve application observability using APM and monitoring technologies such as New Relic and OpenTelemetry . Produce and maintain structured technical documentation, including RFCs, ADRs, System Design diagrams, and BPMN workflows . Lead root-cause analyses and troubleshooting activities and facilitate post-mortems following relevant production incidents. Use AI development tools such as Cursor and GitHub Copilot as part of the engineering workflow, sharing effective prompts, agents, and practices with the broader team. Act as a technical reference across different teams and squads, helping define integration contracts and driving architectural decisions with a high degree of autonomy. Contribute to security, privacy, and data-governance initiatives, including practices related to LGPD and data anonymization . Requirements: Solid professional experience in Backend development with Python . Strong experience designing and building microservices architectures and decoupling monolithic systems. Practical experience with AWS or other major cloud platforms , ideally in large-scale or production environments. Strong knowledge of event-driven architectures and messaging , particularly Kafka and/or RabbitMQ, combined with RESTful API development. Hands-on experience using AI-powered development tools , such as Cursor or GitHub Copilot, to improve engineering productivity and code quality. Strong software quality mindset, including unit and integration testing, code reviews, and automated quality practices. Experience with technical documentation and architectural practices such as RFCs, ADRs, and System Design . Experience with observability and APM solutions, such as New Relic, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, or similar technologies . High degree of autonomy, ownership, self-management, and proactivity when working across multiple teams and technical domains. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the communication skills needed to align technical decisions and integration contracts. Knowledge or previous experience with .NET/C# is a plus, particularly for understanding and modernizing legacy environments. Familiarity with security practices

skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:15d48d0e-8ff3-45ae.title: MarTech Product Manager
skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:15d48d0e-8ff3-45ae.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. Зараз ми у пошуку MarTech Product Manager, який задрайвить напрям MarTech і, за рахунок технічних рішень, допоможе маркетингу досягнути нових рекордів. В Marketing зоні ми маємо: - Експертизу в 10+ каналів Performance Marketing, які тільки можливо закуповувати: Search, Social, Media, Native та інше; - Налагоджену та обширну In-house та Affiliate закупівлю; - 80+ спеціалістів; - Внутрішні команди Funnels та Marketing Analytics; - Близько 10 власних продуктів які допомагають маркетингу працювати максимально ефективно - Ми є одним з найбільших партнерів Google у CEE. Твої майбутні виклики - Постійний пошук та екзекьюшнт нови точок росту для маркетингу (на основі аналізу ринку або внутрішніх досліджень): автоматизація, нові способи оптимізації трафіку, скорочення time‑to‑insight тощо. - Створення та покращення існуючих MarTech продуктів: від discovery до повної імплементації. - Інфраструктура A/B тестів: підтримувати excellence у роботі ключових сервісів - Координувати роботу різних команд: розробники, аналітики, User Acquisition. Ми очікуємо, що ти… - Любиш growth‑hacking й automation: мінімізувати неефективності та множити ROI - Вмієш пояснити складне просто: від junior‑маркетолога до C‑level - Маєш 1+ рік досвіду у ролі Product Manager, Product Owner, Marketing Project Manager або Web Analyst. - Розумієш, як працює Creative Production та тестування воронок - Знаєш як працюють Paid‑канали (FB Ads, Google Ads тощо) і Affiliate‑моделі (CPI, CPA, RevShare) залучення користувачів. У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації: SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті — а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші. Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег — кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки. Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір — від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо. Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці — і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. Наприклад, заснували перший у Європі акселератор для ветеранів https://veteranventure.skelar.tech/ і формуємо майданчик для підтримки ветеранів на рівні держави. Екосистема для продуктивної роботи. Для скеларівців створені простори, які надихають на результат — з власним спортзалом, скеледромом, зеленими зонами Bali та бібліотеками. У спейсах, де сервіс, безпека та комфорт синхронізовані з темпом зростання команд, отримуємо вау-досвід та працюємо ефективніше. Більше розповімо на нашій зустрічі-знайомстві. Запрошуємо будувати the next big everything у SKELAR разом!
